资料型教学建议，未逐片完整观片。
教学建议（待教师看片复核）：建议以拍摄关系本身为讨论对象，分析导演在场与被摄者的回应；包含私密生活与冲突，需先看片，避免把人物当作心理诊断案例。
教学提示：高校教学资料建议，未逐片观片。涉及导演与朋友之间的亲密关系及冲突；课堂应讨论持续同意与双方权力，不从人物表现推断心理诊断。

films.title: Innocent（原名，中文名待核）
films.director: Gek Li San, Ho Choon Hiong
films.topic: 家庭、亲缘与迁徙（编目建议）
films.method: 自我书写（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: At the funeral, one of the directors discovers that her aunt’s death was a suicide. Together, the directors visit the site of her death—a cold concrete building—with the aunt’s husband and children as if to investigate the circumstances of her death. Reviving memories of the spaces that she once lived in through film, the directors points their camera in different directions as if seeking for something beyond the realities of the suicide. Family members and friends, convinced that they know the truth behind her death, are contrasted with those directly affected who maintain their silence. A sense of stagnation in Singapore emerges from cracks in the facts and in the testimonies of relatives as this film propels personal documentary into new directions.

films.title: Fluiding Stage（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 战争、冲突与历史记忆（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: Two men diligently unload equipment and materials from a truck, put pipes together, and build a stage for a puppet theater. No matter how few people are in the audience, the show starts and ends as it always has. Convincingly, as if to impress it on our minds, the camera registers from a corner the dust-covered projector and film lying idle in a warehouse, and the presence of the men steadily going about their business. Quietly criss-crossing people and places with the camera onboard, giving way to cars on the farm road, the traveling puppet theater carries with it the ambience of a bygone era in Taiwan.

films.title: Last House Standing（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 战争、冲突与历史记忆（编目建议）
films.method: 档案/历史材料、自我书写（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: Mr. Jiang is a Shanghai dandy, living by himself in a house that stood the test of time since the 1930s as a witness to what happened to the city. Now, the house is about to be torn down as part of a redevelopment plan. A woman becomes a tenant and fiercely pursues the taciturn man, until he opens his mouth unraveling his unique philosophy and personal history. Combined with the verbal sparring between the two and the scenes around the house, the sadness that oozes from Mr. Jiang’s life at the mercy of Chinese history—Shanghai during the war, the fury of the Cultural Revolution, and now the present—casts a subtle shadow over the film.

films.summary: This film is a bold attempt to conceptualize contemporary media society and the urban images at its core, applying video media as a tool to read and unravel them. Images of the mass media landscape are shown in chapters, using various symbolic aspects of media, audio and video noise as well as principles of the video medium spoken in different languages. While staying clear of the inanity of being a loudmouth as a proper ‘response’, this zestful film is a head-on plea for the possibility of art-in-practice through images.

films.summary: On August 8, 2009, a small Taiwanese village was completely annihilated by a typhoon and large-scale landslide, resulting in countless casualties. Those who survived still wonder why things had to happen this way. Some seek out mediums to realize reunions with the dead, while a couple finds hope in the child they are trying to conceive. There are others who still cannot escape the pain of losing their families. Rigorous and heartrending, A Gift from the Sky meticulously records the never-ending suffering of these villagers, and their spiritual fortitude as they try to rebuild their lives.

films.summary: Three former prostitutes live discreetly in a town ruled by silence, in an abandoned red light district near a U.S. base in the northern Gyeonggi Province of Korea. They entrust us with stories from their tumultuous past, offering poetic monologues that carry the screams of women who cherish the memories that linger with their bodies. Their home will be demolished soon. They bear scars that will not heal in the span of a lifetime. As they wander about the ruins, we witness their resistance against the oblivion of their many memories.

films.summary: This is a record of provincial music made on a journey through three regions of Peru—Ayacucho in the highlands, Amazonas in the Amazon valley, and the coastal area where Lima is located—to listen to the voices and songs of the local people. films.title: Voices from the Waves（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 艺术、媒介与自我反思（编目建议）
films.method: 访谈/口述（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: A continuation of The Sound of the Waves , which screened in the “Cinema with Us” program at YIDFF 2011. Like its preceding work, this film is comprised of conversations between survivors of the March 2011 earthquake and tsunami, as well as interviews where the directors appear on screen. The voices of conversing survivors are recorded together with the voices of those lost in the waves. By layering these conversations, words begin to touch the survivor’s souls, at times overcoming their experiences of the disaster to meditate on the universals of everyday life. Their mourning for all they lost is intermixed with their hope for recovery, in a film that breaks open new borders.

films.topic: 家庭、亲缘与迁徙（编目建议）

films.summary: A daughter struggles to make a film. A mother criticizes this daughter for exposing her and the family. Yet, the daughter harbors something inside that is beyond a simple desire to incite anger. Her mother experienced the “Iron Age,” throwing herself into democratic struggles in a time when authorities raged with incredible violence. She still carries scars that have not healed. The director retraces her own memories of a childhood spent in absence of her activist mother, who was imprisoned after the Gwangju Massacre. As mother and daughter crystallize their various memories in fragments of words, a portrait of the mother and her time emerges.

films.summary: Eleven members of a traditional theatre troupe perform daily and live out their lives in a small playhouse in the Sichuan region of China. Their three-hour show combines various forms, from classical Chinese opera to acrobatics, and is adored by the locals. Their star actress Dandan has performed in the troupe with her mother since she was little, sharing a living space with a group of performers who share no absence of fights. Though she worries about her future, she continues to earnestly perform the heroine for her elderly audience.

films.summary: “I’ve got a talent for suicide.” The director makes a promise with his musician friend to succeed in making a teen movie. But before they can wrap production, the friend commits suicide. In his will, he wrote that he wanted the director to finish the film. Left behind, the director returns to the images they recorded, reuniting the film’s staff and actors and playing the role of his friend himself to complete a film that combines documentary and fiction. This story complicates the natural and the performed, existence and absence, moving toward its own destruction.

films.title: The Targeted Village（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 战争、冲突与历史记忆（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: Takae, Okinawa. As residents resist the construction of helipads that threaten to encircle their village, they are indicted by their government for obstruction. We come to know the shocking truth that during the Vietnam War, Takae villagers were forced to participate in U.S. guerilla warfare training exercises as proxies for Vietnamese villagers. In their struggle against the deployment of the Osprey helicopter, Okinawans completely blockaded the Futenma base. Nevertheless, the aircraft was deployed as planned. Produced by Ryuku Asahi Broadcasting, this film is a direct statement of the Okinawan people’s sadness and fury before the American and Japanese states.

films.topic: 战争、冲突与历史记忆（编目建议）

films.summary: News broadcasts that the Moro Islamic Liberation Front has signed a peace agreement with the Philippine government after a long struggle for independence in Mindanao. But the director’s parents are skeptical. The director, born in southern Mindanao, traces the roots of her father’s family of plantation owners of Islamic descent, and her mother’s lineage of Christian settlers who migrated from Luzon. Individual voices reveal a complicated family history, one that is not encompassed by the simplistic “war zone” narrative broadcast by the media.

films.title: Love Letter to a Place Called Slaughterhouse（原名，中文名待核）
films.originalTitle: Love Letter to a Place Called Slaughterhouse
films.topic: 城市、制度与公共生活（编目建议）
films.method: 档案/历史材料（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: Just a 3-minute walk from Shinagawa Station in Tokyo, there is one of Japan’s largest slaughterhouses. In a corner of the city surrounded by high-rise buildings where people busily come and go, the blood of hundreds of cattle and pigs flows as they become meat. This is a place that deals in the death of animals. There, smeared with feces, urine and blood are the workers who face history and discrimination. What does it mean to work in a slaughterhouse? We carefully look at the workers and their thoughts.

films.title: Tale of a Butcher Shop（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 家庭、亲缘与迁徙（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: In Kaizuka City, Osaka, the family-run Kitade butcher shop makes its living by raising and slaughtering cattle, selling the meat. From the moment of tension when the hammer drops on the forehead of the cow, cattle are transformed into meat through practiced movements. This labor, traditionally the work of the Burakumin, the outcastes of feudal Japan, is passed down to the next generation by parents, who hope their children will not encounter discrimination as they have. People live by eating the lives of others. This is a record of a family who looks into the nature of life, every single day.

films.title: Sound Hunting（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 艺术、媒介与自我反思（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: Production and sale of Fujichrome RT200 sound film stock ended in 1999. The product had a magnetic strip on both sides, allowing audio to be simultaneously recorded from a microphone connected to the camera. It was the ultimate analog technology. Using only this stock, the director begins to shoot a film. As he develops his long outdated and expired RT200, unique visuals and sounds begin to emerge, creating images that are persuasive, yet full of despair.

films.topic: 社会观察与个人经验（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）

films.summary: The storytellers of Tome, Kurihara, and Tono in the Tohoku region of Japan have passed down their tales for generations. They now share their stories with Ono Kazuko, of the Miyagi Folktales Association. These folktales were born from the unforgivingly difficult life in Tohoku, and the tightly knit families that inhabit the region. This work is not only a record of folktales, but also the trust that born from the bond between storyteller and listener and the act of passing on a story.

films.title: Millets Back Home（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 乡土、劳动与生态（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: In a remote ethnic Tayal village nestled in the mountains of Taichung, an old woman is still growing millet. A man who collects trash also raises fruit trees. His son has graduated from middle school but in order to proceed to high school he moves to live alone in the city. One middle-aged woman who works in an adult day-care center was formerly unable to speak the Tayal language but she eagerly absorbs as much of it as she can. Focusing on three families, this film is both a vivid portrayal of the villagers’ way of life as they try to preserve their disappearing traditions, and a testament to the director’s respect for her village, and her people.

films.title: My No-Mercy Home（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 家庭、亲缘与迁徙（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: Dolphin, who approached the director with her story, was sexually abused by her father when she was in middle school. Opposition from her mother and relatives trying to protect her father makes her almost give up, but Dolphin takes legal action against him despite her family’s resistance. Her aim is not only to protect the two younger sisters still living with their family, but in particular to reclaim her own sense of self. She somehow continues her studies, supporting herself financially. With the help of the director and a support group for victims of sexual abuse, Dolphin takes the witness stand.

films.summary: 赵青记录上海一对老年夫妻相互照料的生活，随着记忆和身体状况改变，他们的家庭关系与照护选择逐渐展开。
films.teaching:
高校影视、传媒课程建议：用于家庭纪录片和拍摄伦理课，讨论亲属身份如何影响拍摄准入、陪伴与剪辑决定。涉及阿尔茨海默病、衰老和生命末期议题，须注意脆弱状态下的同意及隐私；影片不作临床诊断教材。本条为资料研究建议，未逐片观片，具体片段与课堂使用须由教师预审。
教学提示：不能以温暖剪辑代表失智症的全部照护处境；讨论被摄者持续同意和尊严，不作医疗判断。
films.courses: 家庭纪录片;媒介伦理;纪录片叙事
films.knowledge: 亲属拍摄;持续同意;照护劳动;日常时间
films.discussion: 拍摄者既是家属又是作者时，应怎样处理家庭内部知情与面向公众传播之间的差别？

films.teaching:
高校影视、传媒课程建议：用于文学与影像及声音剪辑课，分析诗歌、人物声音和劳动场景之间的关系。作品涉及工人诗人许立志之死，需提前说明自杀相关内容，避免将困境浪漫化或推导单一因果。本条为资料研究建议，未逐片观片，具体片段与课堂使用须由教师预审。
教学提示：涉及工伤、劳动困境及诗人死亡/自杀经历；避免浪漫化苦难或自我伤害，教师预审相关段落。

films.knowledge: 群像结构;诗歌转译;声音主体性;劳动再现
films.discussion: 把劳动者的诗变为影片声音时，作者如何保留原作者的语境与表达权？

films.title: 与愤怒的小鸟歌唱（暂译）
films.topic: 音乐、教育、家庭、跨文化交流
films.method: 排练观察、家庭跟拍
films.form: 纪录长片（另有电视短版）
films.summary: 一位在印度浦那组织儿童合唱团的韩国歌唱家，尝试邀请家长与孩子共同排练和演出。工作压力、对音乐教育的疑虑与家庭关系交织在准备过程中。
films.teaching:
教学建议：比较教师目标与家长现实条件，讨论跨文化教育的沟通及权力关系；分析排练如何成为人物互动的场景，避免将当地家庭概括为缺乏教育意识。 本条建议依据公开机构资料，未经逐片完整观片；具体片段请教师预览后选用。
教学提示：跨文化教学存在目标和现实条件差异；避免把家长的顾虑概括为不重视教育。
films.courses: 音乐教育；跨文化传播；教育纪录
films.knowledge: 排练场景；家庭参与；跨文化沟通；多方视角
films.discussion: 当教育者和家长对时间、工作与艺术的优先级不同，纪录片怎样呈现双方理由？
films.selectionBasis: 销售方列IDFA 2016与Sheffield Doc/Fest 2017展映；2018洛杉矶亚太电影节国际纪录长片竞赛。 年份口径：采用销售方Autlook列示2016；87分钟长版与57分钟短版合并计为同一作品。 片名说明：中文片名为本库暂译，尚未核实正式中文发行或影展译名；原名／国际通行名据机构资料。

films.title: Rubber Coated Steel（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 战争、冲突与历史记忆（编目建议）
films.method: 访谈/口述（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: On May 15, 2014, two Palestinian youth—Nadim Nuwara and Muhammad Abu Thahr—were shot and killed by Israeli soldiers in the West Bank. A report on this incident titled, “Nakba Day Killings,” was compiled by Forensic Architecture, a research team of which the director is a part. The film is based on this report. We are shown a scrupulous record of the courtroom proceedings that includes testimony from those who were on the scene when the shots were fired, the back-and-forth between judges and lawyers, and audio analysis of the gunshots. What appears is “the court of silence.”

films.summary: Following the 2011 nuclear disaster, the Oura family was forced to evacuate their home in Namie-cho, Fukushima Prefecture. Several years later, their eldest daughter Miran, who had moved to Tokyo, began filming her family because she wanted to scrutinize the concept of being considered “disaster survivors.” Amidst shifting familial relations—gradually revealed to the viewer—and the continual shock of the realities they confront, each family member is seen groping for their own “road home.”

films.title: 反对普京的无名先生
films.director: 大卫·博伦斯坦（David Borenstein）；联合导演：帕维尔·塔兰金（Pavel Talankin）
films.summary: 一位俄罗斯学校教师用日常摄像工作记录战争背景下学校教育环境的变化，并与外部导演合作完成纪录片。
films.teaching:
高校教学建议：讨论内部视角、隐蔽拍摄、跨境合作与未成年人影像伦理。
教学提示：涉及未成年人、战争宣传、隐蔽拍摄与离境风险；应将拍摄同意问题纳入批评分析，不把隐蔽拍摄当作学生的模仿练习。
films.research: 创意生产 · 文化表征
films.courses: 纪录片创作、纪录片史、影视文本分析
films.knowledge: 内部视角；共同创作；隐私与同意
films.discussion: 作品的公共价值与被摄学生的知情同意、安全风险应如何同时讨论？
films.selectionBasis: 作品身份与基础信息据捷克文化中心《Mr Nobody Against Putin》官方放映资料核对；教学切入点为编目建议，未完成全片逐段观片。 编目说明：补联合导演Pavel Talankin，不能仅列David Borenstein。；制作国按捷克文化中心列丹麦/捷克/德国，移除尚未由当前采用的官方片目证实的英国；发行/播出伙伴不自动等于制作国。；2026年奥斯卡纪录长片奖已通过Academy官方页面确认，并非依据预测或未来消息。
